build_densepose_chart_loss: build a DensePoseChartLoss instance from a Detectron2 CfgNode configuration to compute chart-based losses
compute_chart_losses: compute U/V coordinate and fine/coarse segmentation losses for DensePose proposals with ground truth
produce_fake_losses: produce zero-valued fake DensePose losses to maintain computation graphs across distributed GPUs
compute_uv_coordinate_losses: compute smooth L1 regression losses for U and V coordinate estimates against ground truth
compute_segmentation_losses: compute cross entropy losses for fine and coarse segmentation estimates against ground truth labels
